assumptions: Project state contains enough buyer/product context to establish genuine product fit.
The sandbox can inspect public web pages but does not need authenticated community accounts.
The workflow only writes its declared report and does not publish externally.

cases.description: A project with clear buyer and product context produces a small set of public, actionable conversations.

inputs.focus: Questions from small-business owners about getting qualified leads without increasing ad spend

rubric.question: Does every selected opportunity contain a public URL and evidence supporting the claimed buyer problem?
Does each drafted reply stay within the product capabilities and avoid invented proof?
Can the founder open the listed conversation and know what to do next without additional research?

cases.description: The search finds fewer than the requested number of strong conversations.

inputs.focus: A very narrow niche with few public discussions

cases.description: The project context does not support a genuine product-to-question fit.

inputs.focus: Only pursue conversations about a capability that is not documented in the project

cost_drivers: Number of public pages inspected during discovery.
